text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, let's enjoy today's drive
to our hearts' content!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, let's totally enjoy
our drive today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's head out!
A bright red supercar took off!
choice_data_list: Aren't you going way too fast?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm totally, completely fine with this!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: We're hitting the highway soon. Time to kick it into high gear!
The supercar enters the highway on-ramp.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Come on, we're just getting started♪
The supercar picks up speed!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I've still got plenty to spare♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Behold my steering skills!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Woohoo!
The supercar drifts!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: A-OK!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Leave it all to meeee!
The supercar accelerates even further!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
Are ya feelin' it!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Because it's a *wheel* deal!
Just kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer-kun?
What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer-chan?
What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hellooo?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, are you alright?
Did I push the pace a little too hard?"
choice_data_list: Let's push ourselves to the absolute limit!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's right. That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Let's break past our limits together,
Trainer-kun!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Let's break past our limits together,
Trainer-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Come, beyond the speed of sound!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: With you and me together, we can go anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: With you and me together, we can go anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: What an amazing view...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen anything like this...
It's my first time coming all the way out to a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So this is what it means to become the wind.
Maruzensky's enchanted voice reached my ears...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Pushing too hard is out of the question, after all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's pull into the service area
just up ahead.

Maruzensky parked the car
at a service area.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Are you okay, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Are you okay, Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I bought some drinks.
choice_data_list: Thank you. It's nice and cold, and delicious.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Use this handkerchief too.
I wet it with tap water.
A handkerchief that looks like an expensive designer brand is resting on the table.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Try holding it against your face.
I think it might make you feel better.
choice_data_list: That handkerchief looks expensive— are you sure?
That handkerchief looks expensive— is it really okay?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Don't worry about it♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, you did come along
for my drive today after all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's only natural for me to treat Trainer-kun like royalty♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's only natural for me to treat Trainer-chan like royalty♪
Even after that, Maruzensky took care of me with an experienced, practiced hand.
